$comment: Trigger and behaviour cases. Run on demand (they call a model): see docs/authoring.md#6-evals-before-prose.

expected_behavior: Reads this session's tool calls instead of recalling impressions
Prints at most 3 proposals in the retro block
Checks existing scripts and skills before proposing a new tool

should_trigger.query: What should we automate after this session?
expected_behavior: Cites counts or a verbatim quote as evidence
Proposes a trigger when a tool already exists but went unused

should_trigger.query: Any lessons from the last hour before I write the handoff?
expected_behavior: Prints the block with - none and a reason when nothing clears the thresholds

should_not_trigger: Run a sprint retrospective agenda for my team of six.
Summarise what we changed in this PR.
Write a handoff note for the next session.
